name: Joannes Antonius Colosimo
bioAdditions: Giovanni Antonio was born on 5 July 1679 and baptized on the 7th, son of Francesco Colosimo and Giustina Berardello (S1). He was buried on 1 May 1752 (S2). His wife, mother of Candida (1715), was Fenice Rizulo (S3). She is missing from the tree.

relationships.evidence: Candida's baptism names mother Fenice Rizulo
